description: The presentation presents OBC edtech contracts structured as rate cards in which vendors are paid per student for achieving defined outcome metrics, alongside a base payment for services delivered.
title: Outcome-based contracting (OBC) edtech rate cards tying payment to measured learner outcomes

description: An objective is an explicit statement of what learners should know or be able to do after instruction, serving as the design anchor for activities, materials, and assessment.
title: Objective

description: Observation is the short-form canonical target for instructional activities in which learners watch people, processes, or contexts carefully in order to notice patterns, behaviors, or constraints.
title: Observation

description: Learners observe a live or recorded performance by an expert or peer, then immediately imitate or "shadow" that performance themselves.
title: Observation Shadowing
